== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later [[Come With Me (Errata)|Errata]] / [[Come With Me (PC Errata)|PC Errata]] articles of this family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0 / Supplement) · PC Errata (Appendix A). Same-words Holotable (PC Errata 2, PC Errata 3) fold into PC Errata. Do not add Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
